sloka: युद्धकामेन ताः सर्वा रावणेन हृताः स्त्रियः ।समदा मदनेनैव मोहिताः काश्चिदागताः ॥५-९-६९॥
transliteration: yuddhakāmena tāḥ sarvā rāvaṇena hṛtāḥ striyaḥ ।samadā madanenaiva mohitāḥ kāścidāgatāḥ ॥5-9-69॥

translations.english: Many were brought by Ravana as captives of war and some came on their own deluded by lust.
